thinking.hint: Enable “Supports reasoning” to use this setting. The list contains manual choices, not detected model capabilities: supported values depend on the model, provider and API type. Some models do not allow effort control or disabling reasoning. Default keeps the existing chat and background-task behavior; it does not guarantee that reasoning parameters are omitted. An explicit choice also applies to knowledge-base calls. Check provider documentation: unsupported values may return an API error, and higher effort may increase latency and token usage.

edit.disabledTitle: This message can't be edited right now
edit.entryNotFound: This message is no longer in the current conversation and can't be edited.

edit.gone: This conversation or message no longer exists.

edit.sendFailed: The new branch was created, but sending the edited message failed. Your draft is kept so you can retry.
edit.sessionDeleting: This conversation is being deleted and can't be edited.
edit.sessionSwitched: The conversation changed, so editing was cancelled.
edit.sessionSwitchedSend: The conversation changed, so the changes weren't sent.
edit.staleBranch: The conversation history changed elsewhere, so the changes weren't sent. Reopen the conversation to edit again; your draft is kept.
edit.taskPending: This conversation still has a pending or recoverable learning task, so history can't be edited yet. Finish the current task first.
edit.title: Edit again from this message
edit.unavailable: Could not confirm this conversation's learning-record status; editing was cancelled to avoid damaging learning evidence.
